description: This file is a C++ source code implementing a test application for graphics buffer handling, including server and client buffer classes, buffer creation, monitoring, and a command-line interface for interaction.

classes.name: ServerBuffer
classes.description: A server-side graphics buffer class managing buffer creation, monitoring, and request handling.

classes.name: ClientBuffer
classes.description: A client-side graphics buffer class supporting rendering and publication notifications.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Handles request dispatching for buffer management, including adding, removing, and processing buffer requests.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Inner class of Dispatcher for handling request and offer callbacks.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a new ServerBuffer instance.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Static method to find an existing ServerBuffer by callsign.

methods.name: IsDirty
methods.description: Checks if the server buffer has been modified.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a buffer iterator, resets dirty flag.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Handles buffer request, marks buffer as dirty.

methods.name: Request
